models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Near-calm through tomorrow - Porto Pignataro tonight, motor-sail to Panarea or Stromboli any time after 06:00.
briefing.synopsis: A slack, low-gradient pattern sits over the Aeolians with no organised wind forcing in any run. ECMWF IFS (04 Oct 00Z) and ECMWF AIFS (04 Oct 06Z) agree on single-figure winds through tomorrow, backing from the overnight E/NE at Lipari to NW 3-4 kt by 06:00 and WNW by midday. Seas are essentially flat - MFWAM and ECMWF WAM (both 04 Oct 00Z) hold total wave at 0.1 ft across the island group through 06 Oct. First meaningful change is not until later in the week, with ESE 6-8 kt building for the Panarea-Filicudi leg on 07 Oct.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: Porto Pignataro is the recommendation for tonight - scored 0.998 sheltered, with NNW 2.1 kt, gusts 6.0 kt and 0.1 ft of W swell, all well clear of its exposed arc (200-250°). Marina Lunga and Valle Muria both grade sheltered as well, so the choice genuinely does not matter tonight. Lipari consensus shows 4.0 kt from 029° at 18:00 easing to 2.6 kt overnight; nothing in the payload would push the fleet to shift berth.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: Lipari at 06:00 reads 3.3 kt from 310° with 0.1 ft sea, so expect to motor or motor-sail. Recommended departure is 06:00 for both options, and every window from 06:00 to 14:00 grades go - the day never deteriorates, so there is no hard cut-off to beat. Panarea (12 nm, 029°T) gives a close reach at NW 3.8 kt gusting 7.6; Stromboli (26 nm, 034°T) is a beam reach at the same NW 3.8 kt, arriving around 10:00.

passage_notes.note: NW 3.2-4.5 kt all day, gusts 6.6-9.3, wave 0.1 ft. Close reach early, beam reach by midday. Go at any window; expect engine time. Panarea berth: San Pietro buoy field, sheltered, 2.0 kt SE, 0.1 ft swell.

NW-WNW 3.8-5.4 kt, gusts to 13.6 kt in the midday window - an IFS interval-maximum in light air, not a squall signal. Note Marina del Gabbiano grades only workable: open 0-359°, no anchoring, shelter depends entirely on it staying calm at the forecast N 3.1 kt.

passage_notes.leg: Stromboli → Panarea, optional return (06 Oct, 11 nm, 219°T)
passage_notes.note: ESE-SE 3.0-5.4 kt, gusts to 13.0, wave 0.3 ft. Broad to beam reach, go in all windows.
First real sailing breeze: SSE-ESE 6.1-8.2 kt building through the day, gusts to 18.1, wave 0.8-1.7 ft. Broad reach throughout. Filicudi Porto sheltered at ESE 7.7 kt.
SSE-ESE 4.8-6.2 kt, wave 0.5-0.9 ft, close reach early then head to wind by midday - a motoring leg after 12:00. Rinella recommended, sheltered.

The windiest day in the dataset: SW/W 8.7 kt at 06:00 rising to 17.6 kt and 3.5 ft by the 14:00 window, with the payload flagging deterioration after 11:00. Early start favoured; Portorosa Marina shows W 12.8 kt gusting 26.8 that evening behind enclosed shelter.

cautions: Marina del Gabbiano at Stromboli is open to every direction and anchoring is not permitted - its 'workable' rating rests entirely on the forecast staying at 3.1 kt. Anyone taking the optional Stromboli night should have Panarea as a fallback.
Gust figures from ECMWF IFS are interval maxima, so the 13-14 kt gusts against 4-5 kt means on 05 Oct look worse than they are - they are reported, not treated as a caution.
briefing.confidence_note: IFS, AIFS and ICON-2i agree closely for the next 24-48 h - no model pair differs by more than 6 kt anywhere in the consensus - and run-to-run stability over 12-24 h is averaging 0.5 kt wind shift, though direction can wander about 33° in this light air.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
